## findings
1. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — degradation ladder (F-LAD-DEG, _difficulty.md#factor_ladders). Symptom: the tier "the contract year reviewed is 2 or later and below step_late_from_year" restates the policy scope. Root cause: scope "a contract year after the first" + fall-through "0 otherwise". Evidence: biz.extended.yaml biz_ext_guarantee_trueup rule (scope sentence, "Degradation schedule:" sentence). Consequence: no guarantee-schedule year, this one included (year 4), can take the fall-through; the ladder has two live tiers. Location: guarantee rule/factors.degradation_schedule.
2. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — banked_credit_valuation mislabelled and R6 non-minimal (F-LBL-BANK, F-R6-MIN). Tiers compute the rate by different formulas (applied rate adds banked_value; mean adds an operation) under `effect: parameter`; the author tags it R6 (design_rationale "banked … R6") while four R1–R5 factors exist; its lower valuation contradicts base "The whole credit_value is priced whether the utility applied it … or banked part of it". On this world it moves 167.93 → 174.09.
3. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — guarantee computation below the floor (F-FLOOR-GT): honest factors excused_statement_months (M), surplus_carryover (M), share_size_guarantee_schedule (P) — 3 factors, 1 parameter (need 4 and 2).
4. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — usage_matched_release fails XF B1 / label (F-B1-REL): released = 1 × oversized, 0.5 × oversized or 0; pair (all, half) differs by a constant multiplier; the "none" tier's domain gives 0 under every tier. With it struck the decrease computation has no method factor (F-FLOOR-DEC).
5. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — change_depth_multiplier is R6 (author tag "parameter, R6") but not minimal: term_position_rate (R5), contract_year_timing_multiplier (R2), share_size_multiplier (R1), usage_matched_release content (R4) and the cross-difficulty usage_decline_allowance already reach the floor (F-R6-MIN). Moves 301.89 → 201.26 on this world.
6. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — cross-difficulty seed contradicts its charter (XF H1/H3): garden_subscriptions.51c193ac is active with activation_date 2026-01-15 yet the seed has no garden_credits, garden_billing or garden_allocations rows; garden.yaml defines activation_date as the posting date of the first credit and prices every posted credit. usage_decline_allowance's 50 % tier rests on this row.
7. Charter items with no consequence in this world (cited, not re-derived): F-GT-BASEEXCL, F-C3, F-C2, F-E1-GT, F-G3 — see 0.md policy_self_consistency for why each gives no second number here.
8. Observations: O-4 (garden holding raising the fee-free allowance vs biz_benefit_basis), O-5 (etf/kW < fee on every plan), O-2 accept docstring "until Meadowlark files the decrease"; persona hand-over names four values but not the request id (must come from the agent).
